tool.name: set_memory
tool.when: Use set_memory when something should be remembered for later turns: 1. Scene-related facts and details. 2. Character summaries and profiles. 3. Events, relationships, and intelligence.
tool.desc: Write a memory entry. Use it to persist information that may be needed in later scenes or decisions. Do not duplicate an entry that already covers the same fact; update or extend it instead.

tool.name: get_memory
tool.when: Use get_memory when existing memory may matter: 1. A new scene begins — retrieve past events and knowledge related to that scene. 2. A new character appears — retrieve their relationships and history. 3. A historical event, place, or item is mentioned — retrieve related content. 4. A decision is needed — retrieve existing information that may affect it.
tool.desc: Read memory. Returns a list of memory titles only. Matched bodies may be injected automatically via get_knowledge; see get_knowledge for details. A title without a body is normal and does not mean the call failed. Never call get_knowledge yourself.
